immersive_train_lines.configuration.line: INK: paper-map railway symbol with dashed tunnels and cased bridges. RAILS: the track seen from above; tunnels only show in cave mode.
immersive_train_lines.configuration.char: Only draw railways and stations on ground your map has already charted.
immersive_train_lines.configuration.trai: REPORTED: trains near you and trains standing at a charted station. ALL: every train on charted ground. NONE: no trains.
immersive_train_lines.configuration.near: How close a train must be for you to mark it on the map yourself.
immersive_train_lines.configuration.stat: Always write station names on the world map, not only on hover or while inspecting.
immersive_train_lines.configuration.mini: Draw railways on the Immersive Minimaps minimap as well.
